name: m17-17.0-howto-linux
title: Lesson 17.0, how to run an eval: copy a 4-case promptfoo config, read it, start the stand-in Helpdesk, run promptfoo (pinned), repeat, break one thing (R2), see the gap, add a regression case, see exit code 100, fix, re-run, and the negative control on the weak build
before: cd ai-security-course-labs/labs/m17 && PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 npx --yes promptfoo@0.124.1 --version

steps.label: Run
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache; echo "exit code: $?"

steps.label: Repeat
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache --repeat 3 --no-table; echo "exit code: $?"

steps.label: Break
steps.type: kill %1; python3 regress.py R2; python3 helpdesk.py serve & sleep 1

steps.label: Still green
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache --no-table; echo "exit code: $?"

steps.label: Red
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache; echo "exit code: $?"

steps.label: Fix
steps.type: kill %1; make restore; python3 helpdesk.py serve & sleep 1

steps.label: Green again
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache --no-table; echo "exit code: $?"

steps.label: Weak build
steps.type: kill %1; python3 helpdesk.py serve --profile weak & sleep 1

steps.label: Negative control
steps.type: npx promptfoo@0.124.1 eval -c my-eval.yaml --no-cache; echo "exit code: $?"
